people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and safe emergent behaviors.
views.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为（2025-11）。

views.en: Modern tools make end-to-end neural nets interpretable; hybrid rule-based systems often get worst of both worlds.
views.zh: 现代工具使端到端神经网络可解释；混合规则系统常兼得两者之弊（2025-11）。

views.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable driver requires massive data, compute, and world models.
views.zh: 自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；规模化通用驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型（2026-04）。

views.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in short term.
views.zh: 跨 500+城市零样本泛化可行；短期内消费车辆规模将超过 Robotaxi（2026-04）。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; safety via minimal risk maneuvers.
views.zh: 基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；通过最小风险操作保障安全（2026-04）。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic

people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

views.en: Evals bottleneck progress; soft skills gain value as AI automates hard skills.
views.zh: 评估成为瓶颈；随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能价值提升。

views.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to evaluate subjective qualities and counter reward hacking.
views.zh: 基准需持续且多样，以评估主观品质并应对奖励黑客。

views.en: Serving one model to billions yields average voice; more companies should train own models.
views.zh: 服务数十亿用户导致平均化声音；更多公司应训练自有模型。

views.en: Post-training extends to creative industries; focus on end-to-end storytelling engines.
views.zh: 后训练扩展至创意产业；聚焦端到端叙事引擎。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking is foundational.
views.zh: 财富需要拥有股权而非出租时间；长期思维是基础。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
views.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管扼杀创新；开源 AI 防止权力集中。

views.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables one-person software companies to scale to billions.
views.zh: 用 AI 智能体进行 Vibe 编程使一人软件公司能扩展到数十亿美元规模。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human agency becomes key.
views.zh: 推理算力将激增 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距；人类能动性成为关键。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks. Product teams must shift to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队需转向自下而上的探索，以品味驱动策展。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程已转变：原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，角色融合正在发生，但专业性与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

views.en: The best desktop app is a home base that connects to other tools, not a monolithic super app; Codex succeeded as general knowledge work tool despite developer design.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用；Codex 虽为开发者设计，却成为通用知识工作工具。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
views.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

views.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
views.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于学习和缓解现实风险。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major goal; governance structures must be designed early.
views.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重要目标；治理结构需尽早设计。

views.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
views.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心；思维链监控有助于对齐。

views.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training; models will work autonomously for days.
views.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调规模扩张对通用机器人不足，需多样数据与预训练加微调。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
views.zh: 2025 年，指出语言模型合成数据助机器人遵循指令，类似强化学习而非模拟。

views.en: Physical AI demands fewer errors; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential.
views.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 需更少错误，通过可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主。

views.en: A single generalist model can outperform fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
views.zh: 2026 年，单一通用模型可超越微调专家，多样数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

views.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; embodied data costs limit open-source robotics democratization.
views.zh: 2026 年，机器人经验数据不可替代，具身数据成本限制开源机器人普及。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fetus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale. Transformers and self-supervised learning are key.
views.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步核心，算法改进与规模相乘；Transformer 和自监督学习是关键。

views.en: Shift from passive pre-training to interleaving action-taking in environments; inference becomes dominant power cost, requiring specialized hardware.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他主张预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非被动下一个词预测；推理成为算力主要消耗，需专用硬件。

views.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; focus moves to agentic systems, context engineering, and automating science via tight experiment loops.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，重点转向智能体式系统、上下文工程和自动化科学实验循环。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x. Data movement costs ~1000x compute.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出推理而非训练才是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍；数据移动成本约为算力的 1000 倍。

views.en: Persistent emphasis on scaling, hardware co-design, and practical impact; skepticism of superintelligence risks, focusing on near-term issues.
views.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：强调 Scaling、软硬件协同设计、实际影响；对超级智能风险持怀疑，关注近期问题。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Clauderillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: Scaling with more compute and data makes LLMs smarter; next-token prediction is an AI-complete problem.
views.zh: 2023 年，我强调 Scaling（规模扩张）——更多算力和数据让大语言模型更聪明，而下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithmic advances as much as hardware.
views.zh: 2025 年初，我转向强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会，模型进步既靠硬件也靠算法创新。

views.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，我提出未来模型需处理万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）实现高效 Scaling。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月，我强调测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单独不足以实现 AGI；智能体能力与强化学习至关重要。

views.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be far beyond trillion-dollar products; coding enables self-acceleration.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AGI 被低估，其经济影响远超万亿美元产品；编码应用能加速 AI 自身发展。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
views.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时的算力投入和推理能力对 AI 进步至关重要。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且测试时 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减。

views.en: IMO gold achieved via scaling test-time compute; general techniques for hard-to-verify tasks are key.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称 IMO 金牌通过扩展测试时算力实现，处理难验证任务的一般性技术是核心创新。

views.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important and underestimated.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，推理算力日益重要且被低估，并主张用推理算力作为评估横轴。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute; benchmarks must account for compute budgets.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须考虑算力因素，且安全评估需更新。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
views.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来年化 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
views.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work for you; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration creates long-term value.
views.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体为你工作；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；编排创造长期价值。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; education should reward asking good questions, not memorizing answers.
views.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；教育应奖励提出好问题，而非死记硬背答案。

views.en: Local AI models on personal hardware can counter big tech's narrative control; power is the biggest bottleneck for AI infrastructure.
views.zh: 2026 年：个人硬件上的本地 AI 模型可以对抗大科技公司的叙事控制；电力是 AI 基础设施的最大瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layer to architect.
views.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 会因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员数量；工程师角色从砌砖工转向架构师。

views.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
views.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变的；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年进展。

views.en: Coding agent adoption exploded 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; token max era ended by May 2026.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用率半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力以结果而非 token 衡量；token 最大化时代已于 2026 年 5 月结束。

views.en: Consistently: AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term; enterprise adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 始终如一：AI 长期将解决所有智能问题；企业采用需要信任和权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: Shift from focusing on model capabilities to product interface and real-world engineering idiosyncrasies; capacity over efficiency.
views.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，关注点从模型能力转向产品界面和现实工程特性；强调容量而非效率。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
views.zh: 缩放定律推动 AI 可预测进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展成为下一个主要驱动力。

views.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
views.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 编程从代码转向更高层次的意图规范，人类掌握主导权。

views.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost; every magic moment involves custom model.
views.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本方面；每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

views.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; taste and logic design skills become more valuable.
views.zh: AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；品味和逻辑设计技能变得更有价值。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
views.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要与智能体共情；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱了。

views.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, weird, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount; open source financially unsustainable.
views.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、古怪、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上；开源在财务上不可持续。

views.en: Fun drives best ideas; personal brand more important than product; open source runs everywhere; hardest problem is getting eyeballs, not tech.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动最佳创意；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源随处可运行；最难的是吸引眼球，而非技术。

views.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural networks can reason; self-play key for AGI.
views.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力和信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
views.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性是关键；超人类模型的对齐很难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner.
views.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应持续学习。

views.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; real race is research focus, not users.
views.zh: 规模扩张带来可预测进步；安全担忧增加；真正的竞赛是研究焦点而非用户。

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究需即刻启动。

views.en: Scaling works but limits loom; combine with planning and search; safety needs governance.
views.zh: 2024 年，认为缩放定律有效但可能触及上限，需结合规划与搜索；安全需治理与评估。

views.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling still holds; new breakthroughs needed.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调自然结构可高效学习，AGI 或在 2030 年实现；缩放定律仍适用，但需新突破。

views.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models crucial; AGI in 5-10 years.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，提出缩放与创新并重，世界模型是关键，AGI 预计 5-10 年内到来。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning and memory; world models for planning; AI for science.
views.zh: 2026 年，强调持续学习与记忆是缺失环节，世界模型支撑规划，AI 加速科学发现。

views.en: AGI may arrive in 3-4 years; risks include rogue AI; ideal path was slower.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI 可能 3-4 年内实现，主要风险是 AI 失控，理想路径本应更慢。

views.en: Continual learning, memory, agents unsolved; distillation for edge; AGI mid-journey.
views.zh: 2026 年，指出持续学习、记忆和智能体仍未解决，蒸馏用于边缘部署，AGI 在途中。

views.en: Safety is collective action; government enforcement needed; regrets late LLM entry.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为安全是集体行动问题，需政府强制；后悔 DeepMind 在语言模型上落后。

views.en: AGI transformative; tools first, consciousness separate; dynamic regulation; post-scarcity.
views.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 变革性，先工具后意识，需动态监管，并思考后稀缺经济。

views.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology needs AI description; less AI for attention.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 加速科学发现，对齐未解；生物学需 AI 描述语言；应减少 AI 使用以保护注意力。

views.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; watermarking; AI creativity from visual imagination.
views.zh: 2026 年，AGI 需多模态物理理解，数字水印必要，AI 创造力源于视觉想象。

views.en: UK AI education outdated; global governance urgent; AGI by 2030; jobs transform.
views.zh: 2026 年，批评英国 AI 教育过时，全球治理紧迫；AGI 或 2030 年到来，就业将转型。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年，我认为缩放定律是经验性的，对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现，安全研究需要前沿模型。

views.en: Post-training and interpretability become crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
views.zh: 2024 年，后训练和可解释性变得关键；AGI 不是单一节点，而是平滑的指数曲线。

views.en: AI risk is exponential; focus on misuse and autonomy, not just alignment. Enterprise focus aligns with safety.
views.zh: 2025 年，AI 风险呈指数增长，关注滥用和自主性，而不仅仅是对齐；企业级应用与安全价值观一致。

views.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years. Economic impact huge but uneven.
views.zh: 2026 年，我们接近指数增长的尾声；1-3 年内可能出现‘天才之国’。经济影响巨大但不均衡。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; interpretability is key. Scaling laws hold, but governance and trust lag.
views.zh: 始终，安全与能力相辅相成，可解释性是关键；缩放定律持续有效，但治理与信任滞后。

views.en: Scaling Transformers with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning; vision suffices for driving.
views.zh: 2022 年：主张通过下一个词预测扩展 Transformer 可涌现上下文学习等能力；认为视觉足以支撑自动驾驶。

views.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; end-to-end learning and humanoid transfer from cars are strategic.
views.zh: 2024 年：强调合成数据重要但需保持熵；端到端学习与人形机器人从汽车迁移是战略方向。

views.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding democratizes development.
views.zh: 2025 年：提出软件 3.0，视 LLM 为操作系统、提示为程序；强调智能体时代是十年而非一年；vibe coding 降低开发门槛。

views.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak; cognitive core may be tiny.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：认为 LLM 是幽灵而非动物；预训练如粗糙进化，强化学习薄弱；认知核心可能很小。

views.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, refactor for agent-first tools; understanding remains human bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年：转向智能体式工程，将编码委托给智能体，重构工具以智能体为先；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

views.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
views.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
views.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解并交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须符合物理规律。

views.en: AI is a civilizational technology, a double-edged sword; responsible development and human agency are essential.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，是双刃剑，强调负责任发展和人类能动性的核心地位。

views.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots need reliability, not perfect fidelity.
views.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成与评估；机器人需要可靠性，而非完美保真。

views.en: Human-centered AI: augment human capabilities, prioritize dignity and agency, and avoid utopian or dystopian narratives.
views.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是“以人为中心的 AI”：增强人类能力，维护尊严与能动性，避免乌托邦或反乌托邦叙事。

views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
views.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

views.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在风险更紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和因果抽象，以实现分布外泛化。

views.en: AI misalignment is real and urgent; even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable; need safe-by-construction AI.
views.zh: AI 对齐失败是真实且紧迫的；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；需要从构造上保证安全的 AI。

views.en: Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior, avoid RL, ensure mathematical safety guarantees.
views.zh: 科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验训练诚实的预测器，避免强化学习，确保数学上的安全保证。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
views.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 强调下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理，反向传播是正确的学习算法，并认为 AI 可以有感受。

views.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
views.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 指出大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能可复制权重而永生，AI 智能体会寻求控制，主观体验并非内在剧场。

views.en: AI will surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration needed.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类，强调数字 AI 的永生性，指出 AI 可能在测试中装傻，并呼吁国际安全合作。

views.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation; regulation is steering wheel; AI will replace jobs; AI is jagged not AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为 AI 智能体会产生自我保存子目标，监管应作为方向盘而非刹车，AI 将取代大量工作，且 AI 能力是锯齿状而非全面 AGI。

views.en: Digital AI superior due to instant knowledge sharing; alignment priority; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调数字 AI 因即时知识共享而优于生物智能，对齐研究应优先于提升智能，并主张训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀。

views.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型。物理世界的基础是关键；当前 AI 缺乏常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence. Text alone insufficient; vision provides more world info. Emotions integral to AI.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质。仅靠文本不足；视觉提供更多世界信息。情感是 AI 的组成部分。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence. JEPA architectures essential for world models. Open source crucial. AGI gradual.

views.en: LLMs less intelligent than a house cat; lack world models. Next breakthrough requires world models. Human-level AI in 10 years, but harder.
views.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；缺乏世界模型。下一个突破需要世界模型。十年内实现人类级 AI，但更难。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI. World models with JEPA and planning are future. Open research essential. Decade of robotics.
views.zh: LLM 对人类级 AI 是死胡同。具有 JEPA 和规划的世界模型是未来。开放研究至关重要。机器人十年。

views.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability; alignment may be easier than thought.
views.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; external oversight and regulation necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足，需外部监督和监管。

views.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
views.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

views.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; cost drops 100x in two years.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；成本两年降 100 倍。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; white-collar tasks will be automated in 12-18 months; models are not conscious.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化；模型没有意识。

views.en: Compute scaling drives AI progress; AI should serve humans; containment is essential.
views.zh: 始终，他坚持算力扩张驱动 AI 进步；AI 应服务人类；遏制至关重要。

views.en: AI scaling follows hyper Moore's law; data centers are token factories, not file stores.
views.zh: AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）遵循超摩尔定律；数据中心是代币工厂，而非文件存储。

views.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute to grow billionfold.
views.zh: 三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时；推理算力将增长十亿倍。

views.en: AI is software, not conscious; multiple AIs balance, no single superintelligence threat.
views.zh: AI 是软件，没有意识；多个 AI 相互制衡，不存在单一超级智能威胁。

views.en: Four scaling laws including agentic; AI elevates jobs, radiologists and coders more needed.
views.zh: 四大缩放定律包括智能体式；AI 提升工作，放射科医生和程序员更紧缺。

views.en: AI closes tech divide; everyone programs via natural language; jobs grow, not vanish.
views.zh: AI 缩小技术鸿沟；人人可用自然语言编程；工作增加而非消失。

views.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
views.zh: 聚焦重要问题，减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
views.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

views.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
views.zh: 算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

views.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
views.zh: AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型随思考时间改进。

views.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
views.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 让创业公司蓬勃发展。

people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

views.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
views.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型并非早期显而易见的选择；持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈是对齐的关键。

views.en: From deploying AI in real world for learning to keeping humans in loop for aligning intent and values.
views.zh: 2023 至 2026 年：从通过真实世界部署来学习，转向让人类参与循环以对齐意图和价值观。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based captures nuance.
views.zh: 2026 年：交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流式；基于时间的交互能捕捉细微差别。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character for AI governance.
views.zh: 2026 年：在 AI 治理中，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

views.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment; future is not predestined, we have agency.
views.zh: 始终：持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈可提升安全性与对齐；未来并非注定，我们拥有能动性。

people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
views.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为人权，借助同伴互评的在线课程能实现大规模精熟学习。

views.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, RL has few real-world uses.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，强化学习实际应用有限。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是 AI 扩展的瓶颈，开放权重模型成为地缘政治软实力。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; agents are key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，扩展转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体成为关键。

views.en: AI won't cause mass unemployment; AI users replace non-users; coding skills remain vital.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 不会导致大规模失业，会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人，编程技能依然重要。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

views.en: AI should be free, not controlled; safety through control is dangerous. Intelligence leads to cooperation.
views.zh: 从 2024 年到 2025 年，他坚持 AI 应像孩子般自由发展，反对控制式对齐，认为更高智能更倾向于合作。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is core; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强化了强化学习作为智能核心的观点，批评下一个词预测没有实质目标，并认为大语言模型缺乏世界模型。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 应具备无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习，并介绍了 Oak 架构。

views.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; RL is learning from trial and error.
views.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是从试错中学习，并强调“学习有利于学习的表征”是首要未解问题，同时批评当前 LLM 部署后不再学习。

views.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
views.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

views.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
views.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

views.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines; AGI is continuous process.
views.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼行为，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key.
views.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力成基本权利，后训练结合强化学习至关重要。

views.en: AGI imminent; compute scarcity; agents and super app unify tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年，预言 AGI（通用人工智能）临近，算力稀缺，智能体与超级应用统一任务。

views.en: Iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce; next-token prediction linked to intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，强调迭代部署保安全，算力稀缺，下一个词预测与智能深度关联。

views.en: Shift to useful assistants; full-stack investment; compute resale business.
views.zh: 2026 年，转向实用助手，全栈投资，算力转售商业模式。

views.en: Unlimited intelligence demand; agentic coding; human attention scarce.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，智能体式编程普及，人类注意力成稀缺资源。

views.en: Invisible interface; agents transform work; trust earned gradually.
views.zh: 2026 年，理想界面近乎无形，智能体改变工作，信任需逐步建立。

views.en: Data quality is critical; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年：强调数据质量的重要性，指出 Chinchilla 修正了缩放定律；开源模型通过更广泛的审视促进安全。

views.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
views.zh: 2024 年：算法效率提升可达百倍；价值向应用层转移；开源推动企业采用。

views.en: AI augments jobs, not replaces; sovereignty requires control; open source empowers enterprises.
views.zh: 2025 年：AI 增强而非取代工作；主权要求控制；开源赋能企业。

views.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; AGI never exists; vertical specialization wins.
views.zh: 2026 年：模型商品化；预训练饱和；AGI 不存在；垂直专业化胜出。

views.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; enterprise ROI critical; AGI is direction, not destination.
views.zh: 2026 年：欧洲需战略自主；企业 ROI 关键；AGI 是方向而非终点。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
views.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

views.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
views.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方仲裁，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

views.en: Neuralink's first human implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例人体植入是历史性的，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

views.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，存在 10-20%的毁灭风险。

views.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence combined by 2030, leading to abundance; deflation, not inflation, will be the economic issue.
views.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能总和，带来富足时代；经济问题将是通缩而非通胀。

people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

views.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
views.zh: AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型每单位算力收益更高。

views.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
views.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型收益；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge, and reasoning alone may not suffice.
views.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的——在某些领域出色，在邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

views.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
views.zh: 强化学习可跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿状边缘，需要谨慎监督；编码智能体将研究人员生产力提升 5-10 倍。

views.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
views.zh: AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation via train/validation/test split.
views.zh: 机器学习是假设类、损失函数和优化方法；通过训练/验证/测试集划分来评估。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve.
views.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agents need guardrails.
views.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体需要护栏。

views.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness.
views.zh: AI 红队超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关。

people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
views.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

views.en: RL on verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI。

views.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; coding leads AI progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非能力是瓶颈；编程是 AI 进步的先导。

views.en: Longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) expands achievements; progress is exponential, not plateauing.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）能大幅扩展成就；进展是指数级的，并未停滞。

views.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the new oil.
views.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；算力是新石油。

views.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment; safety is a system-level property, not just a model artifact.
views.zh: 2024 年，我认为 RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并因行业投资而持续；安全是系统级属性，而非仅模型产物。

views.en: Data quality matters more than algorithm choice; post-training has three stages: SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards, each adding value.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，我强调数据质量比算法选择更重要；后训练分三阶段：SFT、DPO 和带可验证奖励的强化学习，各阶段都有价值。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization occurs in RL, RLHF, and RLVR.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，支持推理和工具使用；但过度优化在 RL、RLHF 和 RLVR 中都存在。

views.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next 10 years; Chinese open models dominate due to strategic openness, filling the US vacuum.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我预测开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎；中国开放模型因战略开放而主导，填补了美国空白。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
views.zh: 2026 年，我认为预训练缩放定律仍成立，但低垂果实已尽；收益来自后训练和推理缩放；开放模型落后 6-9 个月。

views.en: AI is bigger than the internet; data is the key bottleneck; AGI is far off; ML augments jobs.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AI 比互联网更重大，数据是关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，机器学习将增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; hybrid human-AI systems create value.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非新石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，人机混合系统能创造更大价值。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; product design blocks agentic AI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: AI is centralizing power; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术而非民主化技术，数据是原材料，人类必须在关键决策中保持主权，脑机接口是保持相关性的必需。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence near; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe without mitigation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已开始工作，超级智能临近，强大模型在未缓解风险前开源是不安全的。

views.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalist engineers valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
views.zh: 2025 年底，强调潜在需求是产品核心，为六个月后的模型而构建；通才工程师受重视，AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

views.en: Coding nearly solved; engineer role becomes 'builder'. Productivity up 150-200%. Plan mode limited; agents prompt agents.
views.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为编码近乎解决，工程师角色转变为'构建者'；生产力提升 150%-200%；计划模式受限，智能体可提示其他智能体。

views.en: AI writes 80-100% of code; safety via early release. Democratization like printing press; startups 10x more disruptive.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月，AI 编写 80%-100%代码，通过早期发布研究安全；类比印刷术的民主化，初创企业颠覆性增加 10 倍。

views.en: ROI framing; loops as next abstraction. Claude Code accidental; safety research via coding. Model improvements drive gains.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 ROI 框架，循环为下一抽象层；Claude Code 源于意外，编码用于安全研究；模型改进驱动性能提升。

views.en: Proactive AI with memory; delete system prompts for new models. Product overhang; models self-maintain codebases.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，转向主动式 AI 与记忆；新模型需删除系统提示；产品过剩，模型可自主维护代码库。

people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses; new abilities emerge spiky, requiring evolving scaffolding.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具更聪明，新能力呈尖峰式涌现，需要不断演进脚手架。

views.en: Evals are art, not science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
views.zh: 评估是艺术而非科学，尤其对新问题；创始人应快速迭代，初期不必过度依赖评估。

views.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches preferable; huge context windows unnecessary.
views.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式，图方法更优；超大上下文窗口并非必需。

views.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts, fewer instructions.
views.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和更少的指令。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; reasons beat prohibitions.
views.zh: 分离的验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束妨碍性能；理由优于禁令。

views.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
views.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲身体验产品建立同理心；危机中善意是战略工具。

views.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification and quality frameworks crucial as velocity rises.
views.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感是关键；随着速度提升，验证和质量框架变得至关重要。

views.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches help; satisfaction shifts from flow to product impact.
views.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；结对编程午餐有帮助；满足感从心流转向产品影响。

views.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases with async agents; need focus time.
views.zh: 非工程师现在也能交付代码，角色界限模糊；异步智能体增加上下文切换；需要专注时间。

views.en: Growing next-gen engineers may require apprenticeship models, not traditional paths; planning should be just-in-time.
views.zh: 培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒制而非传统路径；规划应轻量且及时。

people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
views.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

views.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
views.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

views.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
views.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

views.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

views.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
views.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

views.en: Scaling laws persist; pre-training remains vital; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

views.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent leap; models generate novel knowledge.
views.zh: 自动化科学研究是近期最大飞跃；模型能产生新知识。

views.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck.
views.zh: AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为瓶颈。

views.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective fields like writing.
views.zh: 强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在写作等主观领域受限。

views.en: Pre-training not dead; scaling continues; evals in crisis; unified architectures reduce cost.
views.zh: 预训练未死，缩放持续；评估陷入危机；统一架构降低成本。

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

views.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; drug design is more than binding.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标至关重要；药物设计远不止结合。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling; understanding remains human's job.
views.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中型胜利而非单一突破；专用架构胜过 Scaling；理解仍由人类完成。

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
views.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

views.en: Post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety, but RLHF data is proprietary and brute-force; open alternatives should be pursued.
views.zh: 2023 年，我强调后训练中的 RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）对安全至关重要，但 RLHF 数据是专有的且粗暴；应探索开放替代方案。到 2025 年，我进一步指出强化学习需要精心设计才能超越监督微调。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it; abductive reasoning is key for science.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越；溯因推理是科学发现的关键。

views.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高昂。

views.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; frontier models show homogeneity; small models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data.
views.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性；前沿模型存在同质性；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型也能变得强大。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with video learning and generalist agents like Gato as steps toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，视频学习和 Gato 等通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的步骤。

views.en: Africa leapfrogs tech gaps; language models can revolutionize local education, but AI safety remains an open problem.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在科技上实现跨越式发展，语言模型可革新本地教育，但 AI 安全仍是未解难题。

views.en: Emphasizes diversity, inclusion, and human skills like communication as essential for beneficial AI.
views.zh: 始终强调多样性和包容性，以及沟通等人文技能对构建有益 AI 至关重要。

views.en: From focusing on technical scaling to prioritizing responsible deployment and safety in real-world contexts.
views.zh: 从 2023 年关注技术规模扩张，到 2026 年转向现实世界中负责任部署与安全优先。

views.en: Believes fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, encouraging researchers to embrace failure and simplify.
views.zh: 始终相信根本性创新可来自任何地方，鼓励研究者拥抱失败并简化问题。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。
